description: This is a development entry point file for a Qwik-based web application, responsible for rendering the main Root component into the document using client-side rendering only, with no server-side rendering (SSR). It imports the 'render' function and the Root component, and exports a default function that initiates rendering with provided options.

methods.name: default
methods.description: A default exported function that takes render options and renders the Root component into the document.
